name: gas: a 100 × 40 × 2 plate with a 6 mm rib channel along its middle
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); const rect = (x0, y0, x1, y1) => [{ kind: 'line', a: [x0, y0], b: [x1, y0] }, { kind: 'line', a: [x1, y0], b: [x1, y1] }, { kind: 'line', a: [x1, y1], b: [x0, y1] }, { kind: 'line', a: [x0, y1], b: [x0, y0] }]; m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const s1 = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...itemsToSketch(rect(0, 0, 100, 40)).sketch }); part.features.push(s1, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: s1.id, depth: 2 })); const s2 = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...itemsToSketch(rect(0, 17, 100, 23)).sketch }); part.features.push(s2, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: s2.id, depth: 6 })); }); await sleep(1800); return JSON.stringify({ faces: m.state.partEntry.faces.length }); })()

name: gas: gas assist from a gate at the channel end — the gas runs in the rib only and an 85 % shot fills the part
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('plasticsStudy'); await sleep(400); m.actions.change('op.plastics', () => { const s = m.mfg.plastics.study(); s.gates = [[0.5, 20, 3]]; s.mode = 'midplane'; s.cells = 50; }); await sleep(200); const group = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-field="plGasShot"]')); await m.actions.pmCommand('pl.runGas'); await sleep(400); const g = m.mfg.plastics.gas(); const s = g?.summary; return JSON.stringify({ group, complete: s?.complete, gas: s && s.gasVolume > 0.1 && s.gasVolume < 0.25, shown: Boolean(document.querySelector('.pl-gas-results')), pts: (g?.points.length ?? 0) > 0 }); })()

name: gas: an insert face picked at 20 °C goes into the fill (its nodes counted)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.pmCommand('pl.pickInsert'); await sleep(100); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const top = faces.findIndex((f) => f.geomType === 'PLANE' && Math.abs(f.center.z - 6) < 1e-6); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('plInsertT', '20'); await sleep(100); m.actions.pick({ kind: 'face', index: top, bodyKey: 'body', point: [50, 20, 6] }); await sleep(300); const st = m.mfg.plastics.study(); const r = await m.mfg.plastics.run(); await sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ inserts: st.inserts?.length, temp: st.inserts?.[0]?.temperature, nodes: (r?.insertNodes ?? 0) > 0 }); })()
